the fragmentation of JDA-58 in vitro and in the DU145 xenografted mice leads to a complex multitarget-multidrug combination, which is the hallmark of the combi-targeting concept.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
JDA58 is an example of a “combi-drug,” a molecule designed to carry a multitargeted drug combination that is released upon fragmentation.

a single molecule can be engineered to target two or more molecular targets and can be fragmented to release a combination of active species.

the combi-nitrosourea concept is a promising strategy that could lead to the development of new drugs for cancer treatment.
the “combi-molecules” are not just a single drug, they are a combination of several drugs, each of which has a different mechanism of action.
